title: Adoptado Alma sat chachan sarnaqäwipa
intro: Mä pachanx normas societales ukanakax ch’amanchatäna, mä sapa jaqix mä bendito utanx mä jach’a mayjt’äwiw uñjasiwayi. Jupanakan sarnaqäwipax munasiñamp chikt’ata ukat Diosan kamachipampiw uñt’ayasi, ukax nayra saräwinakan p’akintatapat uñacht’ayi ukat machaq chiqap kamachinakan utt’asitapa. Aka sarnaqäwix chiqaw jach’a tantachäwit sipanx kunja wakiskiris uk uñacht’ayi, ukat Allahan kamachinakapan yatiñanakapax kunjamas uk uñacht’ayi.
clues: Mä kutix katuntat jaqïyätwa, ukampis Diosan wakichäwip tuqiw machaq uta ukat familia jikxatta.
Nayajj wali munatäyätwa, kunapachatï familiajampi ukat adoptat uñjirijampi mä amtar puriñ churapjjetäna ukhajja, qhepat uñjirïñampiw qheparañ amtawayta.
Mä kutix sutijax uywat uñjirijampiw uñt’ayasïna, ukax markajanx wali uñt’atawa.
Naya sapakiw qhipa Profetar masijax sutipax qhanpach Allah ukan Quran ukan arsu.
Mä jach’a warmimpiw jaqichasipxta, jupax Profetan primopänwa, ukampis jaqichasïwijax janiw jaya pachatakïkänti.
Divorciasjjayäta uka qhepatjja, Allah pachpaw nayrir warmijajj Profetampi casarasiñap amtäna, ukhamatwa adoptañ toqet nayra costumbrejj inamayakïjjäna.

identity.label: ¿Khitis nayajja?
options: Bilal ibn Rabah sat chachan sarnaqäwipa
Abu Bakr jupax Siddiq ukham uñt’atawa
Zayd ibn Harithah sat jilataw ukham luräna

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
